Context: 3. Journey fare for children studying at outstations

When both husband and wife are Central Government servants.  
Only one of them is eligible for the concession.  
During transfer.The Government servant may either avail of the concession under this scheme or claim for the children the T.A. admissible on transfer for outward journey. If the concession under this scheme is availed of, a certificate to the effect that no T.A. claim will be preferred for the same child in his Transfer T.A. bill should be furnished by the Government servant.
